newsitem.title: USA: Fifth Third Bancorp names Arnold as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Third Bancorp names Arnold as CFO.

text.p: Fifth Third Bancorp's board said Wednesday it had appointed Senior Vice President Neal Arnold to the post of chief financial officer.
Arnold succeeds Executive Vice President P. Michael Brumm, who will assume responsibility for corporate development activity, including mergers, acquisitions and alliances.
George Schaefer, president and chief executive officer, said, "We have a growth strategy and we don't intend to limit our merger and acquisition activity to financial institutions."
He added, "We have an interest in talking with investment firms, data processing companies, mortgage companies (and) leasing companies."
Fifth Third Bancorp, headquartered in Cincinnati, has $20.2 billion in assets and 411 full-service banking centers.
